caption: The drawing depicts a single vase with a round, bulbous base that tapers into a narrow neck and flares slightly at the mouth. The vase is predominantly a translucent dark pink or reddish color with light marbling and subtle reflections indicating a glass-like texture. Around the widest part of the vase, there are painted floral decorations, including green stems and leaves along with various flowers in yellow, white, and blue hues. A row of small white dots encircles the vase around its neck. The background of the drawing is a uniform light tan color with no additional objects or patterns, and the shadow beneath the vase grounds it to the surface. The artist’s signature is visible in red in the lower right area, just beneath the vase.
title: Water Carafe
